articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process and cross-reference code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement on SWE-bench and ARC-AGI-2 compared to the original GPT-5 release earlier this year, narrowing the gap on tasks previously requiring specialized agent pipelines.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a verified 92% on the 2026 IMO qualifier problem set using a novel chain-of-thought verification architecture that self-audits proof steps. The model introduces a learned formal verification layer that translates natural language proofs into Lean 4 statements, marking a significant step toward automated theorem proving at competition level.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Deploys Second-Generation Humanoid Workers at BMW's Spartanburg Plant
articles.summary: Figure's Figure 03 humanoid robots began full-shift operations at BMW's South Carolina manufacturing facility, handling parts kitting, quality inspection, and inter-station transport. The deployment of over 50 units represents the largest commercial humanoid workforce to date, with BMW reporting a 25% throughput increase in mixed-model assembly lines where the robots operate alongside human workers.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Construction Site Navigation and Heavy Lifting
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released footage and technical details of its electric Atlas robot autonomously navigating unstructured construction environments, carrying 50 kg payloads up scaffolding and across uneven terrain. The system uses a combination of real-time LiDAR SLAM and a vision-language model for semantic understanding of site layouts, enabling it to interpret foreman instructions delivered in natural language.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Auditing Framework as Open Standard
articles.summary: Anthropic open-sourced its Constitutional AI auditing toolkit, providing enterprises with standardized methods to evaluate LLM outputs against customizable safety and policy constraints in production environments. The framework includes red-teaming automation, bias measurement benchmarks, and continuous monitoring hooks compatible with major MLOps platforms, and has already been adopted by the EU AI Office as a reference implementation for AI Act compliance.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has entered risk production at its Kaohsiung fab, approximately one quarter ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node leverages gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, promising a 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, with volume production targeted for late 2027 for leading AI accelerator and mobile SoC customers.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 with 1 Trillion Parameters and Mixture-of-Depths Architecture
articles.summary: Meta publicly released Llama 4, its largest open-weight model featuring a novel mixture-of-depths architecture that dynamically allocates compute across transformer layers based on input complexity. The model matches proprietary frontier models on most benchmarks while running efficiently on clusters of consumer GPUs through aggressive quantization, significantly lowering the barrier for independent AI research and enterprise self-hosting.

articles.title: Quantum Startup QuEra Demonstrates 256 Logical Qubit Error-Corrected Computation
articles.summary: QuEra Computing demonstrated a 256 logical qubit system with real-time quantum error correction sustained over 10,000 error correction cycles, using its neutral-atom architecture. The milestone represents a roughly 10x increase in logical qubit count over previous demonstrations and enabled the first fault-tolerant execution of a quantum chemistry simulation for lithium-sulfur battery electrolyte optimization that exceeded classical HPC baselines.
